games.name: Become Shopping Cart Certified!
games.description:
Grab a shopping cart, run, hop on the bar and RIDE! Can you become Shopping Cart Certified?

4 WORLDS, 160 STAGES: Supermarket, Frozen Foods, Candy Factory and Space Mart, each with 40 different obstacles: lasers, wrecking balls, conveyor belts, ice, trampolines, low gravity and more!

Unlock 15+ cart skins, each with its own speed and turning stats
Hatch eggs and collect pets that boost your coins
Trade pets and send gifts to friends
Season Pass with free and premium rewards
Global leaderboards for coins and completions
Works great on phone, tablet, PC and console

Finish every world and earn your CART CERTIFIED tag!
